rows.question: How many free transfers can I bank?
rows.answer: You can bank a maximum of 5 free transfers in Fantasy Premier League [1][2][4][5].

citations.title: FPL Rules 2026/27: Squad Budget, Transfers, Chips and Scoring, Confirmed
citations.quote: Unused free transfers bank, up to a cap of 5 in total

citations.title: FPL 2026/27 rules digest (internal, fpl-transfer-analyst Skill reference)
citations.quote: Unused FTs bank up to a maximum of 5.

citations.title: FPL Rules Copilot
citations.quote: The maximum number of free transfers you can store in any Gameweek is 5.

citations.title: FPL Help Copilot
citations.quote: Free transfers can be rolled over to a maximum of five in a Gameweek.

rows.question: When does the first Wildcard expire?
rows.answer: The first Wildcard expires at the Gameweek 19 deadline, which is on Saturday, January 2, 2027, at 13:30 [3].

citations.title: FPL Rules Copilot
citations.quote: The first Wildcard will be available after the first Gameweek of your season until the Gameweek 19 deadline of Sat 2 Jan 13:30.

rows.question: What's the points hit for an extra transfer?
rows.answer: An extra transfer costs -4 points in Fantasy Premier League. This applies to any transfer made beyond your free transfer allowance for that gameweek [1][3][5].

citations.title: FPL Beginner's Guide: How to Play Fantasy Premier League
citations.quote: additional transfers beyond your free allotment will cost you **-4 points each**.

citations.title: FPL Help Copilot
citations.quote: Additional transfers in a Gameweek deduct 4 points from your Gameweek score; this is often referred to as taking a “points hit”.

citations.title: FPL 2026/27 rules digest (internal, fpl-transfer-analyst Skill reference)
citations.quote: Each transfer beyond the available FTs costs -4 points in that gameweek (a "hit").

rows.question: What are defensive contribution points?
rows.answer: Defensive contribution points are awarded to players for completing a specific number of defensive actions in a match. Defenders earn 2 points for 10 or more clearances, blocked shots, interceptions, and tackles, while midfielders and forwards need 12 actions to earn the same points. These points do not stack beyond 2 per match [2].

citations.title: FPL Rules Copilot
citations.quote: Any defender who reaches an accumulative total of 10 or more clearances, blocked shots, interceptions (CBI) and tackles in a single match will earn 2 points.

rows.question: Should I use Bench Boost right after a Wildcard?
rows.answer: Using Bench Boost right after a Wildcard can be effective, as it allows you to create a squad with 15 players who all have good fixtures. This strategy is particularly powerful during a Double Gameweek, maximizing your potential points from all players [1][4].

citations.title: FPL Chips Strategy Guide: When to Use Wildcard, Free Hit, Bench Boost
citations.quote: Using Bench Boost immediately after a Wildcard can work well, since you can design a squad specifically with 15 playing players who all have good fixtures.

citations.title: FPL Chip Strategy Guide: When to Play Each Chip
citations.quote: **Best scenario:** During a Double Gameweek, after using your Wildcard to build a squad of 15 players who all have two fixtures.

rows.question: What is effective ownership and why does it matter for captaincy?
rows.answer: Effective ownership (EO) measures a player's impact on rank by combining ownership and captaincy percentages. It matters for captaincy because a player with high EO can significantly affect your rank, even if you own them but don't captain them. If many managers captain a player, their points can hurt your rank if you don't captain them, making EO crucial for strategic decisions.

citations.title: FPL Effective Ownership & Differentials Guide
citations.quote: Effective Ownership is a metric that goes beyond simple ownership percentage. It accounts for how many managers not only own a player, but also **captain or triple-captain them**.

citations.title: FPL Effective Ownership Explained: Why EO Decides Your Rank
citations.quote: Effective Ownership (EO) is the single most important concept for understanding why your rank moves the way it does.

rows.question: Can I cancel a Free Hit after confirming?
rows.answer: No, you cannot cancel a Free Hit after confirming it. Once confirmed, the Free Hit chip is active and cannot be undone [1][3].

citations.title: Triple-Captain in Gameweek 5? How and when to use your FPL chips
citations.quote: The Free Hit chip is played when confirming your transfers. It CANNOT be cancelled after being confirmed.

citations.title: FPL Rules Copilot
citations.quote: This chip is played when confirming your transfers and cannot be cancelled once confirmed.

rows.question: If a player I own rises in price, how much of the profit do I get when I sell him?
rows.answer: When you sell a player who has risen in price, you receive half of the profit from the increase, rounded down to the nearest £0.1m [5]. For example, if a player rises by £0.2m, you gain £0.1m when you sell him.

citations.title: FPL Rules Copilot
citations.quote: you keep half of the increase when selling the player, rounded down to the nearest £0.1m
